newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM books nlg 59 mln Q4 Northwest contribution.
newsitem.headline: KLM books nlg 59 mln Q4 Northwest contribution.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday it had booked a 59 million guilder contribution from its share in Northwest Airlines in KLM's fourth quarter.
"As a result of continued good quarterly results for Northwest Airlines (NWA), equity of NWA, as of March 31 1997, is substantially positive," KLM said in a statement.
"Based on KLM's share in NWA, a contribution of 59 million guilders is reported under results of holdings in KLM's fourth quarter," it said.
Even though Northwest Airlines had returned to positive equity, KLM had not been expected to book its share of its U.S. partner's profits.
It said in February only that it expected to book its share of Northwest profits during the course of 1997 but did not specify when.
